choices.h: 1.2 d, d = (m/rho)^(1/3) (fixed density => fixed h for every N)
choices.softening: both eps = 0 (pure Newton) and eps = 0.5 h (engine default), reported separately
choices.c_s: sqrt(K/rho) for iron, K from Mentat elastic_analysis hydrostatic stress (Tait's dP/drho)
choices.central_parcel: parcel nearest the barycentre; mass x 1.1; r measured from it
choices.fit_window: [2h, R] per design (R = seeded cloud radius)
supplementary_declared_now: seeds 1..10 at every N (noise of the U slope)
short-range control: kernel pair energy sum_i m_i rho_i^SPH
Tait EOS pressure response and sum m P/rho (exploratory)
virial-balance (Jeans-locus) crossing N* of the two fitted laws

predictions.slope_U_engine_pe_j_seed7: 5/3 + 0.0103 (finite-N factor 1-1/N) = 1.6770, plus single-seed sampling noise of order 0.01-0.02; predicted PASS of 1.667 ± 0.03 (not certain)
predictions.slope_E_P: 1.000 exactly [BY CONSTRUCTION]; sum m P_i/rho_i (isothermal, engine) = M c_s² to roundoff
predictions.U_engine_over_U_mentat: (N-1)/N on average (iid uniform points; continuum includes self-pairs)
predictions.gravity_response_eps0_N256: -2.000 to < 1e-9 [BY CONSTRUCTION: dm enters only the pair term G dm/r²]
predictions.gravity_response_eps0.5h_N256: -1.886 (secant) -> FAILS -2.00 ± 0.05: softening bias, a design defect not physics
predictions.pressure_response_beyond_2h: NOT zero: the isothermal/Tait force on i uses P_j/rho_j² of i's neighbours j, and rho_j changes for every j within 2h of the perturbed parcel, so the response reaches 4h (two kernel hops). Predicted FAIL of the design clause.
predictions.pressure_response_beyond_4h: identically 0.0 (bitwise) — the corrected criterion; at N = 256 R/h = 3.28 < 4 so no parcel lies beyond 4h (clause vacuous there); tested at N = 2048
predictions.short_range_control_slope: between 1.0 and 1.25, local slopes falling toward 1 (bulk N + negative surface N^(2/3) term)
predictions.tait_sum_mP_over_rho: exploratory: Poisson sampling inflates interior rho_SPH by m W(0) = rho/(pi k³) = +18 %, so bulk Tait P ≈ +0.18 K; sign/slope not a criterion

design_corrections_known_before_running: Pressure support is 4h, not 2h: SPH density sum (2h) followed by the symmetric pressure force over neighbours (2h).
The gravity -2.00 ± 0.05 band holds only for eps = 0 or for a window starting beyond ~3.84 h when eps = 0.5 h (local slope (s²-2r²)/(r²+s²), Mentat).
At fixed density with k = 1.2, R/h = 3.28 at N = 256: the window [2h, R] spans only a factor 1.64 in r and contains no parcel beyond 4h.
E_P = M c_s² (isothermal) is extensive by construction; the U slope is the only engine-measured exponent, and it can fail only if the pair sum is not 1/r or the seeding is not at fixed density.
corrected_pass_fail: SEPARATE if slope_U = 1.667 ± 0.03 (seed 7; also the 10-seed mean) AND slope_E_P = 1.00 ± 0.01 AND gravity response = -2.00 ± 0.05 (eps = 0 over [2h,R] at N = 256; eps = 0.5 h over [4h,R] at N = 2048) AND pressure response identically 0 beyond 4h (N = 2048) while non-zero somewhere in (2h, 4h). SAME if slopes within 0.1.
